en: Fixed Agent SDK sessions crashing when a user message contains an image with a malformed `source`, and failing on every later turn after a malformed document block; a malformed image is now replaced with an explanatory note
zh: 修复 Agent SDK session 在用户消息包含 `source` 格式错误的图片时崩溃，以及在出现格式错误的文档块后后续每一轮都失败的问题；格式错误的图片现在会被替换为说明性提示
